lessons.title: Kutheni sifuna imali?
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 1
lessons.body:
# Siyakwamkela!

Siyakwamkela kwi-Bitcoin Diploma. Kule veki siza kufunda ukuba kutheni imali ibalulekile ebomini bethu.

Imali siyisebenzisa yonke imihla: xa sithenga isonka evenkileni, xa sihlawula iteksi, xa sithengisa kwi-spaza. Kodwa ingaba siyazi ukuba **kutheni** siyidinga, kwaye **yintoni** kanye imali?

> "Imali sesona sixhobo singundoqo sokukhulula abantu." – Friedrich Hayek

---

# Dibana noSatoshi

Molo! NdinguSatoshi. Ndiza kuhamba nawe kwesi sifundo se-Bitcoin Diploma.

Kwiiveki ezizayo siza kufunda:
- ukuba yintoni imali nokuba isebenza njani
- imbali yemali ukusuka kudala ukuya namhlanje
- ukuba yintoni i-Bitcoin nokuba ungayisebenzisa njani
- indlela yokugcina iisats zakho zikhuselekile

Veki nganye kukho isifundo esifutshane nemibuzo embalwa. Uphendula imibuzo kakuhle, ufumana **7,000 sats**.

---

# Imibuzo emihlanu ngemali

Ngaphambi kokuba siqhubeke, cinga ngale mibuzo mihlanu. Cinga ngezinto zokwenyani obomini bakho, ezifana nokutya nezinto ozithengayo yonke imihla.

- Kutheni sifuna imali?
- Yintoni imali?
- Ngubani olawula imali?
- Yintoni eyenza imali ibe nexabiso?
- Ngowuphi umbuzo onawo wena ngemali?

Akukho mpendulo ingachanekanga apha. Gcina iimpendulo zakho engqondweni: siza kubuyela kuzo ekupheleni kwesifundo.

---

# Kutheni sifuna imali?

Khawucinge ngosuku lwakho. Ufuna ukutya, amanzi, umbane, iimpahla, uthutho. Akukho mntu unokwenza zonke ezi zinto yedwa.

Imali isinceda:
- **sithenge** izinto esizidingayo kwabanye abantu
- **sithengise** esikwenzayo okanye esinako
- **songe** ngoku ukuze sibe nento ngomso
- **sazi ixabiso** lezinto, size sithelekise

Kutheni singenakusuka sikhabe ilitye kuvele imali? Kuba imali ibaluleke kuba ayifumaneki lula. Siza kufunda ngakumbi ngale nto kwiiveki ezizayo.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

> Imali sisixhobo esisinceda sitshintshiselane ngezinto, songe, kwaye sazi ixabiso lezinto.

Kwiveki ezayo siza kufunda ukuba **yintoni kanye** imali, kwaye yenza ntoni.

Ngoku cofa u-"Ndigqibile ukufunda" uze uphendule imibuzo.

lessons.title: Yintoni imali? Imisebenzi yayo emithathu
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 2.0–2.2
lessons.body:
# Yintoni imali?

> "Imali sisiqinisekiso sokuba singanayo le nto siza kuyifuna." – Aristotle

Wakhe wazibuza ukuba yintoni kanye imali? Abaninzi bethu bayakwazi ukuyisebenzisa, kodwa abaninzi abazi ukuba ivela phi okanye isebenza njani.

**Imali sisixhobo sokunaniselana ngeempahla neenkonzo.** Ichaza ixabiso lezinto ukwenzela kube lula ukurhweba.

---

# Imali sisivumelwano

Imali sisivumelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ukuba iqela labantu livumelana ukusebenzisa into ethile ukuhlawula, loo nto iba yimali.

Umzekelo: ukuba sonke ekasi sivumelana ukuba sihlawule ngeetshokoleyithi, iitshokoleyithi ziba yimali yethu. (Kodwa iyanyibilika elangeni, ngoko ayiyiyo imali elungileyo!)

**Unaniselwano** kukutshintshiselana ngeempahla okanye iinkonzo phakathi kwabantu ababini okanye ngaphezulu, umzekelo ukuthenga isangweji evenkileni.

---

# Umsebenzi 1: Isixhobo sokutshintshiselana

[[picture:bd25-w02-1]]

Ngaphandle kwemali, ukuba wena unemifuno kwaye ufuna isonka, kufuneka ufumane umntu onesonka **ofuna imifuno**. Kunzima!

Ngemali akunyanzelekanga ukuba ukhangele lo mntu ufuna kanye le nto unayo. Uthengisa imifuno yakho ngemali, uze uthenge isonka ngaloo mali.

> Imali yenza ukurhweba kube lula.

---

# Umsebenzi 2: Iyunithi ye-akhawunti

Imali sisilinganiso esivunywa ngumntu wonke, esisinceda sichaze kwaye sithelekise amaxabiso.

Umzekelo: xa uthenga ifowuni, ungathelekisa amaxabiso ezivenkile ezahlukeneyo ngoko nangoko, kuba onke abhalwe ngeerandi.

Ukuba ibingekho le yunithi, bekuza kufuneka uthelekise ngezinto ezahlukeneyo: "Le fowuni ixabisa iinkukhu ezi-3 okanye iingxowa zomgubo ezi-2?" Kunzima kakhulu!

---

# Umsebenzi 3: Ukugcina ixabiso

Imali elungileyo kufuneka **igcine ixabiso layo ixesha elide**. Ngolo hlobo ungonga namhlanje uze uthenge ngomso.

Le nto inceda abantu bacwangcisele ikamva: ukonga kwesikolo sabantwana, ukwakha, okanye ukuqala ishishini.

Ukuba imali ilahlekelwa lixabiso ngokukhawuleza, ukonga kunzima. Siza kufunda ngakumbi ngale nto kamva.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

Imali inemisebenzi emithathu:
- **Isixhobo sokutshintshiselana**: sithenga, sithengise ngayo
- **Iyunithi ye-akhawunti**: sibala, sithelekise amaxabiso ngayo
- **Igcina ixabiso**: songa ngayo ngoku ngenxa yangomso

Cinga ngomzekelo: uThandi wonga inxalenye yomvuzo wakhe ukuze athenge isitovu kwinyanga ezayo. Lo ngumsebenzi wokugcina ixabiso.

questions.question: Imali sisixhobo sokwenza ntoni?
Imali inemisebenzi emingaphi esifunde ngayo kule veki?
UThandi wonga imali yakhe ukuze athenge isitovu kwinyanga ezayo. Ngowuphi umsebenzi wemali lo?
USipho uthenga isonka nge-R20 kwi-spaza. Ngowuphi umsebenzi wemali lo?
Uthelekisa amaxabiso efowuni kwiivenkile ezimbini, zombini zibhale ngeerandi. Ngowuphi umsebenzi wemali lo?
Kutheni itshokoleyithi ingeyiyo imali elungileyo?
Ngaphandle kwemali, yintoni enzima xa ufuna ukurhweba?
choices: Ukufumana umntu onale nto uyifunayo kwaye ofuna le nto unayo

questions.question: Imali yinto evunyelwene ngayo ngabantu. Yintoni eyenza into ibe yimali?
choices: Xa iqela labantu livumelana ukuyisebenzisa ukuhlawula

lessons.title: Iimpawu zemali elungileyo neentlobo zemali
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 2.3–2.4
lessons.body:
# Iimpawu zemali elungileyo

Ngokuhamba kwexesha, abantu baye baqonda ukuba imali kufuneka ibe neempawu ezithile ukuze isebenze kakuhle.

Zintandathu:
- **Ukomelela**
- **Ukuphatheka**
- **Ukwahlulahluleka**
- **Ukufana** (ukutshintsheka)
- **Ukunqongophala**
- **Ukwamkeleka**

Masijonge nganye nganye.

---

# Ukomelela nokuphatheka

[[picture:bd25-w03-1]]

**Ukomelela**: imali akufuneki ivuthuluke okanye iguge nokuba ihlala ixesha elide. Igolide iqine kakhulu, ayigubeki. Ngoko yomelele.

Inkomo ayomelelanga njengemali: iyagula, iyaguga, iyafa.

**Ukuphatheka**: kufuneka ukwazi ukuyiphatha uhambe nayo. Ikhadi lebhanki lingena lula esipajini. Kodwa inkomo ayiphatheki lula xa usiya evenkileni!

---

# Ukwahlulahluleka nokufana

[[picture:bd25-w03-2]]

**Ukwahlulahluleka**: imali kufuneka iqhekezwe ibe zixa ezincinci, ukuze uthenge into encinci okanye enkulu. I-R100 ingatshintshwa ibe zii-R10 ezilishumi.

Inkomo ayinakwahlulwa: awunakuthenga isonka ngomlenze wenkomo!

**Ukufana**: iyunithi nganye kufuneka ilingane nenye. I-R10 enye ilingana ncam nenye i-R10. Kodwa iinkomo azilingani: enye inkulu, enye incinci.

---

# Ukunqongophala nokwamkeleka

[[picture:bd25-w03-3]]
[[picture:bd25-w03-4]]

**Ukunqongophala**: imali kufuneka inqabe, ingabikho yonke indawo. Ukuba wonke umntu angayenza ngokulula, ixabiso layo liya kuwa.

Amagqabi emithi awanakuba yimali: angqingwe kuyo yonke indawo!

**Ukwamkeleka**: imali kufuneka yamkelwe ngumntu wonke njengentlawulo. Ukuba i-spaza ayiyamkeli, ayiluncedo kuwe.

> Xa zonke ezi mpawu zimandla, imali iba luncedo kakhulu kurhwebo nakuqoqosho.

---

# Iintlobo zemali

Kudala nanamhlanje, kukho iintlobo ezahlukeneyo zemali:

- **Imali yesimbiwa esinexabiso**: into enexabiso ngokwayo, efana negolide nesilivere.
- **Imali emeleyo**: iphepha elimele into ebambekayo, umzekelo isatifikethi sesilivere onokusitshintshela ngesilivere.
- **Imali yesiqhelo** (fiat): imali ekhutshwa ngurhulumente neBhanki enguVimba, efana neerandi. Ayimelanga golide; ixabiso layo lixhomekeke ekuthembeni.

Kukwakho **iimali zika-intanethi** ezisetyenziswa kwiintlawulo ze-intanethi. I-Bitcoin yenye yazo: siza kufunda ngayo kamva.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

> Imali elungileyo yomelele, iyaphatheka, iyahlulahluleka, iyafana, inqongophele, kwaye yamkelekile.

Zama oku: cinga ngenkomo, igolide, neerandi. Yeyiphi enezona mpawu zininzi zemali elungileyo? Siza kubuza i-Bitcoin lo mbuzo mnye kamva kwesi sifundo.

lessons.title: Ukunqongophala, umonde nokukhetha
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 2.5
lessons.body:
# Imali nengqondo yethu

Kule veki sijonga indlela esicinga ngayo xa sisebenzisa imali. Kukho izinto ezintathu ezibalulekileyo:
- **Ukunqongophala**
- **Umonde wexesha**
- **Ukuncama** (into oyiphulukanayo xa ukhetha)

---

# Ukunqongophala

Masithi uhamba entlango, unebhotile enye yamanzi. Ungawasela onke ngoku, okanye ungarhabula kancinci ixesha elide.

Kufuneka ukhethe, kuba amanzi **anqongophele**: akaneli ukwenza konke ofuna ukukwenza.

Le nto ayenzeki emanzini kuphela. Imali, ixesha namandla ethu nawo anqongophele. Ngoko sisoloko sikhetha indlela yokuwasebenzisa kakuhle.

---

# Iindidi ezimbini zokunqongophala

**Ukunqongophala kwendalo**: izinto ezinqabileyo ngokwendalo, ezifana negolide. Akukho mntu unokwenza igolide eninzi ngokulula.

**Ukunqongophala okwenziwa ngumntu**: inkampani okanye urhulumente ugqiba ukuba makubekho into engakanani. Umzekelo, ukuba inkampani ilawula amanzi edolophu, ingenza ukuba abe nqongophele okanye abize kakhulu.

> Umahluko omkhulu lulawulo: ngubani onokugqiba ukuba makubekho into engakanani?

---

# Umonde wexesha

Ukhethiswa: **R100 namhlanje**, okanye **R110 ekupheleni konyaka**?

- Umntu ongenamonde ukhetha i-R100 ngoku. Ufuna into ngoku.
- Umntu onomonde ulinda i-R110. Ujonge phambili, kwikamva.

Oku kubizwa ngokuba **ngumonde wexesha**: ukulinda inzuzo enkulu ngomso endaweni yento encinci ngoku.

Akukho mpendulo ilungileyo ngalo lonke ixesha, kodwa abantu abanomonde bakwazi ukonga nokwakha ikamva.

---

# Ukuncama: into oyiphulukanayo

Zonke izigqibo zifuna ukuba uncame enye into.

Umzekelo: une-R7. Ungathenga isiselo ngoku, okanye ungayonga.
- Ukuba uyathenga, uncama oko ubunokukwenza nge-R7 kamva.
- Ukuba uyayonga, uncama isiselo ngoku.

Into oyincamayo xa ukhetha ibizwa ngokuba **yilahleko enokuvela** (opportunity cost).

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

> Izinto ezilungileyo zinqongophele, ngoko sikhetha. Wonke ukhetho luncama enye into. Umonde unceda ukwakha ikamva.

Ngale veki ugqibe isahluko sesi-2: ngoku uyazi ukuba yintoni imali, imisebenzi yayo, iimpawu zayo neentlobo zayo. Kwiveki ezayo siqala imbali yemali!

Inkampani elawula amanzi edolophu ingenza ntoni?

Ingenza amanzi abe simahla kuwo wonke umntu

lessons.title: Imbali yemali: ukusuka kunaniselwano ukuya kwiingqekembe
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 3.0–3.1.2
lessons.body:
# Imali yaqala njani?

Kudala kakhulu, abantu babengenayo imali engamaphepha okanye iingqekembe. Babetshintshiselana ngezinto: amaqokobhe, ityuwa, iinkomo, igolide.

Imali ayenziwanga ngoorhulumente ekuqaleni. **Yavela ngokwayo**, kuba abantu babefuna indlela elula yokurhweba.

---

# Unaniselwano: ukutshintshiselana ngezinto

[[picture:bd25-w05-2]]

Masithi uJoseph unebhanana, ufuna ikhokhonathi. UYael unekhokhonathi, kodwa ufuna imengo. UTammy unemengo, kodwa ufuna ibhanana.

Bobathathu bafuna ukurhweba, kodwa akukho babini bafuna kanye into yomnye. Le ngxaki ibizwa ngokuba **kukungadibani kweminqweno**.

> Ukurhweba ngokutshintshiselana kuyasokolisa kwaye kutya ixesha.

---

# Iingxaki zemali zakudala

Abantu bazama izinto ezininzi njengemali. Kodwa ezininzi zazineengxaki:
- **Iinkomo** azahlulahluleki, ziyagula, aziphatheki lula.
- **Ukutya** kuyabola.
- **Amaqokobhe** angaqokelelwa ngumntu wonke elwandle, ngoko alahlekelwa lixabiso.

Abantu baye bakhetha izinto ezinqabileyo nezomeleleyo, ezifana negolide nesilivere.

---

# Iingqekembe zegolide nesilivere

[[picture:bd25-w05-1]]

Kwinkulungwane ye-7 phambi kokuzalwa kukaKristu, uKumkani Alyattes waseLydia (namhlanje yiTurkey) wenza iingqekembe zokuqala ezaziwayo.

Iingqekembe zegolide nesilivere zazinexabiso ngokwazo, kwaye kwakulula ukuzibala. Kodwa zazineengxaki:
- zinzima xa uphethe ezininzi
- abanye abantu babezinyibilikisa, baxube nesinyithi esitshiphu

---

# Iirisiti ezingamaphepha

Ukusombulula ezi ngxaki, abantu baqala ukugcina igolide yabo kwindawo ekhuselekileyo, baze bafumane **irisiti ephepha**. Le risiti yayimele igolide, kwaye ungayitshintsha ngegolide nanini na.

Ezi risiti zaqala eTshayina. Kwakulula ukuziphatha nokurhweba ngazo. Le yayiyimali yokuqala engamaphepha, kwaye yayimele into yokwenyani: igolide.

> Imali ingamaphepha yaqala njengerisiti yegolide.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

- Kudala abantu babetshintshiselana ngezinto (unaniselwano).
- Unaniselwano lunzima, kuba kufuneka ufumane umntu ofuna kanye into onayo.
- Abantu bakhetha izinto ezinqabileyo nezomeleleyo: igolide nesilivere.
- Iingqekembe zalandelwa ziirisiti ezingamaphepha ezimele igolide.

Kwiveki ezayo: ukusuka ephepheni lemali ukuya kumakhadi nakwi-intanethi.

lessons.title: Ukusuka ephepheni ukuya kwiplastiki nakwi-intanethi
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 3.1.3–3.2
lessons.body:
# Ukusuka kwimali eqinileyo ukuya kwimali engaqinanga

[[picture:bd25-w06-2]]

Kwinkulungwane ye-17, abantu bagcina igolide yabo ezibhankini. Kodwa iibhanki zaqala ukuprinta **iirisiti ezingaphezulu kwegolide ezinayo**.

Oku kwazinika iibhanki inzuzo, kodwa kwathetha ukuba ayingawo onke amaphepha ayemele igolide yokwenyani.

> Le yayiyindlela yokuqala yokuba imali ingabi namva into yokwenyani.

---

# Ukuphela kwegolide emva kwemali

[[picture:bd25-w06-1]]

- Phambi kweMfazwe yeHlabathi yokuQala, wawukwazi ukutshintsha imali yakho ephepha ngegolide.
- Iimfazwe nokudodobala koqoqosho ngo-1929 zatshintsha oko.
- Ngo-1944 (iBretton Woods), idola yase-US yaba yimali enguvimba yehlabathi, ibotshelelwe kwigolide: $35 nge-awunsi.
- Ngo-1971, uMongameli Nixon waphelisa ukutshintsha idola ngegolide.

Ukusukela ngoko, imali yehlabathi **ayibotshelelwanga** kwigolide. Ixabiso layo lixhomekeke ekuthembeni.

---

# Ixabiso eliguquguqukayo

[[picture:bd25-w06-3]]

Ngoku ixabiso lemali lihla linyuka ngenxa yezinto ezininzi: unyuko-maxabiso, inzala, ipolitiki, urhwebo lwehlabathi.

Oku kwenza kube nzima ukuyisebenzisa njengesilinganiso samaxabiso. Cinga ngeR100: wayethenga zingaphi izinto kwiminyaka eli-10 eyadlulayo, kwaye ithenga zingaphi ngoku?

---

# Ukusuka ephepheni ukuya kwiplastiki

Ngeminyaka yoo-1950 kwafika **ikhadi lokuthenga ngetyala** (credit card). Ngokuswayipha nje, ungathenga nantoni na.

Kodwa kukho ingxaki: ukuthenga ngetyala kwenza abantu bathenge izinto abangenamali yazo. Amatyala ayakhula, kwaye amaxabiso ayenyuka.

---

# Imali ka-intanethi

Ngoku sibhanka nge-app, sithenga kwi-intanethi, sithumela imali ngefowuni. Imali ka-intanethi ikhona kwiikhompyutha kuphela.

Ininzi kule mali ka-intanethi ilawulwa ziibhanki neenkampani. Zinokuyibona yonke intlawulo yakho, kwaye zinokuyimisa.

Kwiiveki ezizayo siza kubona ukuba i-Bitcoin yahluke njani: yimali ka-intanethi **engalawulwa ngumntu omnye**.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

- Iibhanki zaqala ukuprinta amaphepha angaphezulu kwegolide ezinayo.
- Ngo-1971 idola yayeka ukubotshelelwa kwigolide.

lessons.title: Imali yesiqhelo: ngubani oyilawulayo?
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 4.0–4.2.1
lessons.body:
# Imali yesiqhelo (fiat)

[[picture:bd25-w07-1]]

Imali esiyisebenzisayo namhlanje, efana neerandi, ibizwa ngokuba **yimali yesiqhelo** okanye i-fiat. Ixabiso layo alikho kwigolide: lixhomekeke **kumthetho** nasekuthembeni.

"Fiat" ligama lesiLatin elithetha "makwenzeke". Urhulumente uthi: "le yimali", kwaye kufuneka uyamkele.

---

# Ukususwa kwegolide ebantwini

[[picture:bd25-w07-2]]

Ngo-1933, eMelika, uMongameli Roosevelt wakhupha umyalelo (onguNombolo 6102) owanyanzela abantu ukuba banikezele ngegolide yabo kurhulumente. Bafumana iphepha le-$20.67 nge-awunsi.

Ngo-1934, urhulumente wenyusa ixabiso legolide laya kwi-$35. Oko kwathetha ukuba **imali esephepheni yabantu yalahlekelwa lixabiso** ngobusuku obunye.

> Imbali ibonisa ukuba oorhulumente neebhanki bangatshintsha ixabiso lemali yakho ngaphandle kwemvume yakho.

---

# Iibhanki ezinguVimba

Ngo-1913 kwasekwa i-Federal Reserve, ibhanki enguVimba yaseMelika. Namhlanje uninzi lwamazwe lunebhanki enguVimba. EMzantsi Afrika yiBhanki enguVimba yoMzantsi Afrika (SARB).

IBhanki enguVimba:
- ikhupha imali yelizwe
- ibeka inzala
- incedisa iibhanki xa zisengxakini

---

# Inkqubo emiselwe ngumthetho

[[picture:bd25-w07-3]]

Kule nkqubo, igcuntswana labantu ligqiba ukuba makubekho imali engakanani. Bangaprinta imali entsha nanini na.

Idola yase-US ibalulekile kwihlabathi liphela: izigqibo ezithathwa eMelika zichaphazela nemali yethu, kunye namaxabiso epetroli nokutya eMzantsi.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

- Imali yesiqhelo (fiat) ixabiso layo limiselwe ngumthetho, hayi ngegolide.
- Ngo-1933 abantu baseMelika banyanzelwa ukunikezela ngegolide yabo.
- IBhanki enguVimba ikhupha imali yelizwe kwaye ibeka inzala.
- Igcuntswana labantu ligqiba ukuba makubekho imali engakanani.

lessons.title: Iibhanki, amatyala nokuba ngubani oxhamlayo
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 4.2.2–4.3
lessons.body:
# Ibhanki yenza imali ngamatyala

Xa ufaka imali ebhankini, ibhanki ayiyigcini yonke. Igcina inxalenye encinci (umzekelo 10%), ize ibolekise ngenye.

Umzekelo: ufaka i-R100. Ibhanki igcina i-R10, iboleke umntu i-R90. Lo mntu uyifaka kwenye ibhanki, nayo iboleke i-R81... Ekugqibeleni, imali ejikelezayo ingaphezulu kakhulu kwe-R100 yokuqala.

> Le mali intsha yenziwa ngamatyala. Le nkqubo ibizwa ngokuba kukugcina isixa esithile kuvimba (fractional reserve).

---

# Ibali likaDax nesithuthuthu

UDax uboleka isithuthuthu sakho. Ke uthembisa abahlobo abaninzi ukuba angababoleka sona ngexesha elinye.

Ekuqaleni yonke into ihamba kakuhle, kuba ayinguye wonke umntu ofuna isithuthuthu ngaxeshanye. Kodwa ngenye imini, **bonke** bafika befuna ukukhwela. Sinye kuphela isithuthuthu sokwenyani!

---

# Xa wonke umntu efuna imali yakhe

Iibhanki zinje ngoDax. Xa abantu abaninzi befika ngaxeshanye befuna imali yabo, ibhanki ayinayo yonke. Oku kunokwenza ibhanki iwe.

Xa oko kusenzeka, iBhanki enguVimba iyangenelela inike ibhanki imali entsha. Ngoko le nkqubo iphila ngamatyala, kwaye imali iya isanda.

---

# Ngubani oxhamlayo?

[[picture:bd25-w08-1]]

Xa kuprintwa imali entsha, ayifiki kumntu wonke ngaxeshanye. **Abo bayifumana kuqala** (iibhanki, oorhulumente, iinkampani ezinkulu) bayisebenzisa ngaphambi kokuba amaxabiso enyuke.

Abo bayifumana kamva (abasebenzi, oonozinti, abantu basekasi) bafika amaxabiso sele enyukile.

---

# Iimali ze-intanethi zeBhanki enguVimba (ii-CBDC)

Oorhulumente abaninzi bacinga ngemali ka-intanethi yabo, ebizwa ngokuba **zii-CBDC**. Ziyafana nemali yesiqhelo, kodwa zenza urhulumente abone kwaye alawule yonke intlawulo.

Siza kubuyela kwii-CBDC kwiveki yama-20.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

- Iibhanki zigcina inxalenye encinci yemali yakho, ziboleke enye: imali intsha yenziwa ngamatyala.
- Xa wonke umntu efuna imali yakhe ngaxeshanye, iibhanki azinayo yonke.
- Abo bafumana imali entsha kuqala bayaxhamla; abo bayifumana kamva bahlawula amaxabiso aphezulu.

lessons.title: Unyuko-maxabiso namandla okuthenga
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 5.0–5.1
lessons.body:
# Yintoni unyuko-maxabiso?

**Unyuko-maxabiso** (inflation) lwenzeka xa kukho imali eninzi kuqoqosho kunezinto zokuthenga. Ngoko amaxabiso ayenyuka, kwaye imali yakho ithenga izinto ezimbalwa.

Oku kubizwa ngokuba **kukuhla kwamandla okuthenga**.

---

# Ifandesi yebhotile yamanzi

UAlex, uBob noCharlie ngamnye une-R10. Kukho ibhotile enye yamanzi ethengiswayo.

Ngoku umntu othile (urhulumente) unika ngamnye wabo enye i-R10. Ngoku bane-R60 bebonke, kodwa **isekuyibhotile enye**.

Bonke bayayifuna. Baqala ukukhuphisana: "R15!" "R20!" Ixabiso lebhotile liyenyuka, nangona ibhotile ingatshintshanga.

> Imali eninzi + izinto ezifanayo = amaxabiso aphezulu.

---

# Imali eninzi, amandla amancinci

[[picture:bd25-w09-1]]

Kulo mzekelo, abahlobo banemali engakumbi, kodwa abakwazi ukuthenga amanzi amaninzi. Amandla abo okuthenga ehlile.

Kwenzeka into enye ebomini bethu: umvuzo wakho ungenyuka kancinci, kodwa isonka, iteksi, umbane, nesitya senyuka ngokukhawuleza.

---

# Unyuko-maxabiso lurhafu efihlakeleyo

Xa urhulumente eprinta imali entsha, akakuceli, kodwa uyakuhlawulisa: imali ese-pokothweni yakho ithenga kancinci.

Abantu abanemali encinci bachatshazelwa kakhulu, kuba bachitha yonke imali yabo kwizinto ezisisiseko: ukutya, uthutho, umbane.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

- Unyuko-maxabiso: imali eninzi kunezinto, amaxabiso ayenyuka.
- Amandla okuthenga ayehla: imali enye ithenga kancinci.
- Unyuko-maxabiso lufana nerhafu efihlakeleyo.
- Abasokolayo bachatshazelwa kakhulu.

Zama oku: buza umntu omdala ukuba isonka sasixabisa malini xa wayesemncinci.

lessons.title: Amatyala ehlabathi nokungalingani
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 5.2
lessons.body:
# Imali ebanceda abambalwa

[[picture:bd25-w10-1]]

Kwiveki ephelileyo sibone ukuba unyuko-maxabiso luthatha amandla okuthenga. Kule veki sijonga ukuba le nkqubo yemali yenza njani **umsantsa phakathi kwezityebi namahlwempu** ukhule.

---

# Ngubani ofumana imali entsha kuqala?

Xa kuprintwa imali, ifika kuqala kwiibhanki, oorhulumente, neenkampani ezinkulu. Bathenga izindlu, umhlaba, izabelo, **phambi kokuba amaxabiso enyuke**.

Abantu abaqhelekileyo bayifumana kamva, ngomvuzo, xa amaxabiso sele enyukile. Ngoko izityebi zityeba ngakumbi, abasokolayo basokola ngakumbi.

> Kufana nomdlalo we-Monopoly apho abadlali abambalwa banazo zonke iihotele.

---

# Oorhulumente ematyaleni

[[picture:bd25-w10-2]]
[[picture:bd25-w10-3]]

Kwimali eqinileyo (igolide), urhulumente wayengenakuchitha imali angenayo. Ngemali yesiqhelo, oorhulumente bangaboleka kwaye baprinte, bangene ematyaleni amakhulu.

Amatyala ehlabathi ngoku makhulu kakhulu. Ngubani oza kuwahlawula? Ngokuqhelekileyo, abantu, ngerhafu nangonyuko-maxabiso.

---

# Ukungalingani akukho malunga nemali kuphela

Ukungalingani kumalunga nokuba **ungakwazi na ukuzithengela izinto ozidingayo** nokuba ungaphuma na endlaleni.

Abantwana abazalelwa kumakhaya angathathi ntweni banobunzima bokuphuma kwintsokolo, kuba imali abayonga ilahlekelwa lixabiso minyaka le.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

- Imali entsha ifika kuqala kwabatyebileyo, abathenga phambi kokuba amaxabiso enyuke.
- Umsantsa phakathi kwezityebi namahlwempu uyakhula.
- Oorhulumente bangena ematyaleni amakhulu, abantu bawahlawule.
- Ukonga kunzima xa imali ilahlekelwa lixabiso.

Kwiveki ezayo: iqela labantu elazama ukwakha imali engcono.

lessons.title: Ii-cypherpunks nephupha lemali engalawulwa ndawonye
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 5.3
lessons.body:
# Ii-cypherpunks zingobani?

Ngenkulungwane yama-20, kwafika iikhompyutha ne-intanethi. Iqela labantu labona ukuba ezi zixhobo zingasetyenziselwa **inkululeko** okanye **ukubeka abantu phantsi kweliso**.

Aba bantu babizwa ngokuba **zii-cypherpunks**: iingcali zekhompyutha, ze-cryptography (ukubhala ngemfihlo), namatshantliziyo enkululeko.

---

# Babefuna ntoni?

Ii-cypherpunks zazifuna:
- **ubumfihlo**: iinkcukacha zakho zibe zezakho
- **ukhuseleko** ku-intanethi
- **imali ka-intanethi** engalawulwa ngurhulumente okanye ngebhanki

Ngo-1993, uEric Hughes wabhala "Umqulu we-Cypherpunk", ocacisa ukubaluleka kobumfihlo.

---

# Ulawulo lwendawo enye nolungelulo

[[picture:bd25-w11-1]]
[[picture:bd25-w11-2]]

**Inkqubo elawulwa ndawonye** (centralised): iqumrhu elinye (ibhanki, urhulumente, inkampani) linamagunya onke. Lingavala i-akhawunti yakho, liyeke iintlawulo zakho.

**Inkqubo engalawulwa ndawonye** (decentralised): amagunya ahlulwe kubantu abaninzi. Akukho mntu mnye unokuyivala yonke.

> Ukuba ibhanki iyawa okanye ivala i-akhawunti yakho, imali yakho iyaphela. Kwinkqubo engalawulwa ndawonye, akukho mntu mnye unokwenza oko.

---

# Amalinge okuqala emali ka-intanethi

Ngaphambi kwe-Bitcoin, abantu bazama:
- **DigiCash** (uDavid Chaum, 1989)
- **B-money** (uWei Dai, 1998)
- **Bit Gold** (uNick Szabo, 1998)
- **Reusable Proof-of-Work** (uHal Finney, 2004)

Ezininzi zawa, kuba zazilawulwa yinkampani enye, okanye zazingasombululi ingxaki yokuchitha imali kabini.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

- Ii-cypherpunks zazilwela ubumfihlo nemali engalawulwa ndawonye.
- Inkqubo elawulwa ndawonye inamagunya kwindawo enye; engalawulwa ndawonye yahlulwe kubantu abaninzi.
- Amalinge amaninzi emali ka-intanethi awa phambi kwe-Bitcoin.

Kwiveki ezayo: uSatoshi Nakamoto nokuzalwa kwe-Bitcoin!

lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 6.0–6.1
lessons.body:
# USatoshi Nakamoto

[[picture:bd25-w12-2]]

Ngo-2008, umntu (okanye iqela) obizwa ngokuba **nguSatoshi Nakamoto** wapapasha iphepha elithi: "Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System".

Akukho mntu uyaziyo ukuba ungubani na uSatoshi. Ngo-2010 waphuma, wayishiya i-Bitcoin ezandleni zabantu abayisebenzisayo.

> I-Bitcoin yaba sisiphumo seminyaka engama-40 yophando lwee-cypherpunks.

---

# Kutheni ngo-2008?

[[picture:bd25-w12-1]]

Ngo-2008 kwabakho ingxaki enkulu yezimali ehlabathini. Iibhanki ezinkulu zawa, oorhulumente baprinta imali eninzi ukuzisindisa, kwaye abantu abaqhelekileyo baphulukana namakhaya nemisebenzi.

Kwibloko yokuqala ye-Bitcoin (3 Janyuwari 2009), uSatoshi wabhala intloko yephephandaba malunga noorhulumente abasindisa iibhanki. Kwacaca ukuba i-Bitcoin yayiyimpendulo kule nkqubo.

---

# I-Bitcoin isebenza njani?

I-Bitcoin **ayinabhanki, ayinamphathi**. Endaweni yoko:
- Kukho **ileja** (incwadi yeerekhodi) yazo zonke iintlawulo, ekwabelwana ngayo ngamawaka eekhompyutha ehlabathini.
- Wonke umntu angaqinisekisa ileja.
- Akukho mntu mnye unokuyitshintsha.

---

# Ukuvumelana kukaNakamoto

[[picture:bd25-w12-3]]

Indlela iikhompyutha ezivumelana ngayo ukuba yeyiphi intlawulo eyiyo ibizwa ngokuba **kukuvumelana kukaNakamoto**.

Abantu abaphambili kwi-Bitcoin:
- **Iingcali ezivelisa ii-bitcoin** (miners): zifaka iintlawulo kwileja, zivuzwe ngee-bitcoin ezintsha.
- **Izitishi zokuqinisekisa** (nodes): zihlola ukuba yonke intlawulo ilandela imithetho.
- **Abasebenzisi**: abantu abafana nawe, abathumela nabafumana i-bitcoin.
- **Abaphuhlisi**: abantu ababhala ikhowudi.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

- USatoshi Nakamoto wapapasha iphepha le-Bitcoin ngo-2008; akukho mntu uyaziyo ukuba ungubani.
- I-Bitcoin yaqala ngo-3 Janyuwari 2009, emva kwengxaki yezimali.
- I-Bitcoin ayinabhanki: inileja ekwabelwana ngayo, eqinisekiswa ngabantu abaninzi.
- Iingcali ezivelisa, izitishi zokuqinisekisa, abasebenzisi nabaphuhlisi bonke banendima.

lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 6.2
lessons.body:
# Ingaba i-Bitcoin yimali elungileyo?

[[picture:bd25-w13-2]]

Kwiveki 3 sifunde iimpawu ezintandathu zemali elungileyo. Ngoku masijonge i-Bitcoin ngokwazo.

---

# Ukomelela nokuphatheka

**Ukomelela**: i-Bitcoin ikwi-intanethi, ayiguge, ayibola, ayitshi. Ileja ikhuselwe ngamawaka eekhompyutha.

**Ukuphatheka**: ungathwala izigidi zee-rand nge-bitcoin efowunini yakho, okanye ukhumbule amagama ali-12 entloko yakho! Ngo-2020, kwathunyelwa i-$1.1 bhiliyoni nge-Bitcoin, umrhumo uyi-68 yeesenti kuphela.

---

# Ukwahlulahluleka nokufana

**Ukwahlulahluleka**: i-bitcoin enye yahlulwa ibe zii-**sats** ezizigidi ezili-100. I-sat enye yi-0.00000001 BTC. Yiyo loo nto ufumana iisats ezi-7,000: zincinci, kodwa zi-bitcoin yokwenyani.

**Ukufana**: i-sat enye ilingana nayo nayiphi na enye i-sat.

---

# Ukunqongophala

Le yeyona mpawu ibalulekileyo:

> Ziyi-**21 yezigidi** kuphela ii-bitcoin eziza kubakho. Akukho mntu unokuprinta ezingaphezulu.

Imali yesiqhelo ingaprintwa nanini na. I-Bitcoin inqongophele ngendlela ebhaliweyo kwikhowudi, njengegolide kodwa ngcono.

---

# Ukwamkeleka nokuzithathela uxanduva

[[picture:bd25-w13-1]]

**Ukwamkeleka**: i-Bitcoin isakhula. Amashishini amaninzi ehlabathini nase-Mzantsi Afrika ayayamkela. Nakwi-ekasi lethu, iivenkile ezithile ziyamkela i-Lightning.

**Uxanduva**: ngaphandle kwebhanki, nguwe ophetheyo. Kufuneka ugcine i-wallet yakho ikhuselekile. Siza kufunda indlela kwiiveki ezizayo.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

- I-Bitcoin yomelele, iyaphatheka, iyahlulahluleka (zii-sats), iyafana.
- Zi-21 yezigidi kuphela ii-bitcoin: akukho mntu unokuprinta ezingakumbi.
- Ukwamkeleka kusakhula.
- Nge-Bitcoin, nguwe onoxanduva lwemali yakho.

lessons.title: Ukufumana nokutshintsha i-Bitcoin
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 7.0–7.1
lessons.body:
# Ungayifumana njani i-Bitcoin?

Kukho iindlela ezininzi zokufumana i-bitcoin:
- **Ukuyisebenzela**: ufumane umvuzo nge-bitcoin, njengoko ufumana iisats ngokufunda kule app!
- **Ukuthengisa** ngezinto okanye iinkonzo, uhlawulwe nge-bitcoin.
- **Ukuyithenga** ngeerandi.

---

# Ukusuka emntwini ukuya komnye: ngobuqu

[[picture:bd25-w14-2]]

Ungatshintshiselana nomntu omaziyo nomthembileyo: umnika iirandi, akuthumelele i-bitcoin efowunini yakho.

Oku kulula kwaye akufuni bhanki. Kodwa:
- rhweba nabantu obathembileyo kuphela
- qinisekisa ukuba i-bitcoin ifikile phambi kokuba umnike imali

---

# Ukusuka emntwini ukuya komnye: ku-intanethi

Kukho iiwebhusayithi ezidibanisa abathengi nabathengisi (peer-to-peer). Uthenga ngqo kumntu, kodwa iwebhusayithi iyakhusela.

Lumkela amaqhinga! Abantu abakuthembisa inzuzo enkulu ngokukhawuleza bahlala bengamasela.

> Ukuba into ilunge kakhulu ukuba yinyani, ngokuqhelekileyo ayiyonyani.

---

# Iinkampani zokutshintsha (exchanges)

[[picture:bd25-w14-1]]

Iinkampani ezifana nezo zithengisa i-bitcoin ngeerandi. Zilula, kodwa:
- zifuna iinkcukacha zakho (ID)
- zigcina i-bitcoin yakho ukuba awuyikhuphi
- zinokuvala i-akhawunti yakho okanye ziwe

Ngoko emva kokuthenga, **khupha i-bitcoin uyise kwi-wallet yakho**.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

- Ungayifumana i-bitcoin ngokusebenza, ngokuthengisa, okanye ngokuthenga.
- Ungatshintshiselana ngqo nomntu omthembileyo.
- Iinkampani zokutshintsha zilula, kodwa zigcina i-bitcoin yakho: yikhuphe uyise kwi-wallet yakho.
- Lumkela amaqhinga.

lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 7.2–7.6
lessons.body:
# Yintoni i-wallet?

[[picture:bd25-w15-1]]

Ii-bitcoin aziphili efowunini yakho. Zikwileja ye-Bitcoin. I-wallet yakho igcina **inombolo-mfihlo yabucala** (private key): isitshixo esibonisa ukuba ii-bitcoin zezakho.

> Ophethe isitshixo, uphethe ii-bitcoin.

---

# Ezakho ngokupheleleyo okanye ezigcinwa ngomnye

**I-wallet esezandleni zakho ngokupheleleyo** (self-custody): nguwe ophethe isitshixo. Akukho mntu unokuyivala.

**I-wallet elawulwa lelinye iqumrhu** (custodial): inkampani ikugcinela isitshixo. Kulula, kodwa uthembe yona.

Zombini zinendawo. Into ebalulekileyo kukwazi ukuba yeyiphi onayo.

---

# Ibinzana-mfihlo (seed phrase)

[[picture:bd25-w15-2]]

Xa uvula i-wallet yakho, ufumana **amagama ali-12 okanye ama-24**. Eli libinzana-mfihlo lakho.

- **Libhale phantsi ephepheni**, uligcine kwindawo ekhuselekileyo.
- **Ungaze ulinike mntu**, nokuba uthi uvela kwiBitcoin Ekasi.
- Ungalifoti, ungalibeki kwi-WhatsApp.

Ukuba ifowuni yakho ilahlekile, la magama abuyisa ii-bitcoin zakho kwifowuni entsha. Ukuba umntu uyawafumana, angathatha zonke ii-bitcoin zakho.

---

# Ukonga nge-Bitcoin

[[picture:bd25-w15-3]]

Kuba ii-bitcoin zinqongophele, abantu abaninzi bazisebenzisa ukonga ixesha elide. Kodwa:
- ixabiso le-bitcoin lihla linyuka kakhulu ngexesha elifutshane
- yonga kuphela oko ungakudingiyo kungekudala

---

# Ungathembi namnye, qinisekisa kuqala

Kwi-Bitcoin akukho zinkokeli. Ungakholelwa umntu kuba ethetha kamnandi. Qinisekisa ngokwakho:
- ukuba idilesi ichanekile phambi kokuthumela
- ukuba i-app oyikhuphayo yeyokwenyani
- ukuba umntu okucela ibinzana-mfihlo **ulisela**

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

- I-wallet igcina isitshixo sakho, hayi ii-bitcoin ngokwazo.
- Self-custody: nguwe ophetheyo. Custodial: inkampani ikugcinela.
- Ibinzana-mfihlo (amagama ali-12/24): libhale, ligcine, ungaze ulinike mntu.
- Ungathembi namnye, qinisekisa kuqala.

lessons.title: I-Lightning Network
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 8.0–8.2
lessons.body:
# Kutheni i-Lightning?

Iintlawulo kwileja ye-Bitcoin ziqinile kakhulu, kodwa zingathatha imizuzu eli-10 okanye ngaphezulu, kwaye umrhumo ungaba phezulu xa kuxakekile.

Ukuthenga isonka okanye iteksi, sifuna into ekhawulezayo netshiphu. Yiyo loo nto kukho **i-Lightning Network**.

---

# I-Lightning isebenza njani?

[[picture:bd25-w16-1]]
[[picture:bd25-w16-2]]

I-Lightning ingumgangatho wesibini phezu kwe-Bitcoin. Abantu abababini bavula **itshaneli**, bafake i-bitcoin kuyo. Emva koko bangathumelelana kaninzi, ngokukhawuleza, **ngaphandle kokubhala kwileja** rhoqo.

Xa begqiba, ibhalansi yokugqibela ibhalwa kwileja ye-Bitcoin kanye.

---

# Umzekelo: ityala evenkileni

Uhlala evenkileni yokutya imini yonke. Endaweni yokubhatala isihlandlo ngasinye, uvula ityala. Emva kwemini, wena nomnikazi-venkile nijonga ityala, uhlawule kanye.

Ngoku cinga ngamawaka abantu besenza oko ngaxeshanye, bekwazi nokuhlawula abanye **ngokuhamba kwiitshaneli zabanye**. Yile Lightning Network!

---

# Iintlawulo ze-Lightning

- **Zikhawuleza**: zifika ngemizuzwana.
- **Zitshiphu**: umrhumo uhlala uyi-sat enye okanye ezimbalwa.
- **Zincinci**: ungathumela nesat enye.

Iisats zakho zeBitcoin Ekasi zifika nge-Lightning kwidilesi yakho ye-Lightning (umzekelo igama@blink.sv).

---

# Iintlobo zee-wallet ze-Lightning

Njengee-wallet ze-Bitcoin, kukho:
- **ezilawulwa nguwe**: nguwe ophethe isitshixo
- **ezilawulwa lelinye iqumrhu**: inkampani ikugcinela, kodwa zilula kakhulu ukuqala

Ii-wallet ezifana neBlink, Fedi, Aqua, Wallet of Satoshi zinazo iidilesi ze-Lightning.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

- I-Lightning yenza iintlawulo ze-bitcoin zikhawuleze kwaye zitshiphu.
- Isebenza ngeetshaneli, ngaphandle kokubhala kwileja rhoqo.
- Iintlawulo zifika ngemizuzwana, nomrhumo omncinci kakhulu.
- Iisats zakho zeBitcoin Ekasi zifika nge-Lightning.

lessons.title: Ukuthumela nokufumana nge-Lightning, nokuthenga ekasi
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 8.3–8.5
lessons.body:
# Ukuvula i-wallet ye-Lightning

1. Khuphela i-app ye-wallet kwi-Google Play okanye App Store. Qinisekisa ukuba yeyokwenyani.
2. Vula i-app. Bhala phantsi ibinzana-mfihlo ukuba iyakunika lona.
3. Fumana **idilesi yakho ye-Lightning** okanye ikhowudi ye-QR.
4. Yinike umphathi weBitcoin Ekasi ukuze iisats zakho zifike apho.

---

# Ukufumana iisats

[[picture:bd25-w17-1]]

Kukho iindlela ezimbini:
- **Idilesi ye-Lightning** (igama@wallet): njenge-imeyile. Umntu uthumela kuyo nanini na.
- **I-invoyisi**: wenza isicelo semali esinemali ethile. I-wallet yakho ibonisa i-QR. Umntu uyiskena, ahlawule.

---

# Ukuthumela iisats

1. Cofa "Thumela" (Send) kwi-wallet yakho.
2. Skena i-QR okanye ufake idilesi.
3. **Hlola imali nedilesi kakuhle.** Intlawulo ye-Lightning ayibuyi.
4. Cofa uqinisekise. Kugqityiwe ngemizuzwana!

> Intlawulo ye-Bitcoin ayinakubuyiswa. Hlola kabini, thumela kanye.

---

# Ukuthenga ekasi nge-Bitcoin

[[picture:bd25-w17-2]]
[[picture:bd25-w17-3]]
[[picture:bd25-w17-4]]

Amashishini amancinci ehlabathini nase-Mzantsi Afrika aqala ukwamkela i-Lightning: ii-spaza, iivenkile zekofu, abathengisi basezitratweni.

Le nto yakha **uqoqosho olujikelezayo**: abantu bafumana iisats, bazichithe ekasi, abathengisi bazichithe kwakhona. Imali ihlala ekuhlaleni.

Ii-painted shacks ziyinxalenye yoku: zibonisa ukuba i-Bitcoin ikhona apha ekasi.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

- Vula i-wallet, bhala ibinzana-mfihlo, fumana idilesi ye-Lightning.
- Fumana ngedilesi ye-Lightning okanye nge-invoyisi.
- Xa uthumela: hlola imali nedilesi kabini. Ayibuyi.
- Ukuchitha iisats ekasi kwakha uqoqosho olujikelezayo.

lessons.title: Ubuchwepheshe be-Bitcoin: izitshixo nee-hash
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 9.0–9.2
lessons.body:
# Ukubhala ngemfihlo

**I-encryption** kukuguqula umyalezo ube yikhowudi engafundekiyo, ngaphandle kokuba unesitshixo. **I-decryption** kukuwubuyisela ufundeke.

Kufana nesefu: ngumntu onesitshixo kuphela onokuyivula.

---

# Isitshixo sabucala nesikawonke-wonke

I-Bitcoin isebenzisa izitshixo ezimbini:
- **Inombolo-mfihlo yabucala** (private key): eyakho yedwa. Uyisebenzisa ukutyikitya, ubonise ukuba ii-bitcoin zezakho.
- **Inombolo-mfihlo kawonke-wonke** (public key): yenziwa kweyabucala. Ungayinika wonke umntu; ivelisa iidilesi zokufumana.

> Kufana nebhokisi yeposi: wonke umntu angafaka ileta (public), kodwa nguwe kuphela onesitshixo sokuyivula (private).

---

# Yintoni i-hash?

[[picture:bd25-w18-1]]
[[picture:bd25-w18-2]]
[[picture:bd25-w18-3]]

I-hash ithatha nantoni na (igama, incwadi, intlawulo) iyiguqule ibe linani elide elikhethekileyo, njengomnwe womntu.

- Kwigalelo elinye, ihlala inika i-hash enye.
- Ukuba utshintsha nonobumba omnye, i-hash itshintsha ngokupheleleyo.
- Awunakubuyela kwi-hash uye kwigalelo.

I-Bitcoin isebenzisa i-hash ebizwa ngokuba yi-SHA-256, ukukhusela ileja.

---

# Imodeli ye-UTXO

I-Bitcoin ayinayo "ibhalansi" njenge-akhawunti yebhanki. Endaweni yoko, inezinto ezifana neengqekembe ezingasetyenziswanga, ezibizwa ngokuba zii-**UTXO**.

Umzekelo: une-UTXO ye-0.5 BTC. Ufuna ukuthumela i-0.3. Uyichitha yonke i-0.5: i-0.3 iya kumntu, i-0.2 ibuyela kuwe njengetshintshi (kususwe umrhumo).

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

- I-encryption ifihla imiyalezo; isitshixo siyayivula.
- Isitshixo sabucala sesakho yedwa; esikawonke-wonke ungasinika abanye.
- I-hash ngumnwe wolwazi: utshintsho oluncinci, i-hash entsha ngokupheleleyo.
- I-Bitcoin isebenzisa ii-UTXO, ezifana neengqekembe ezinetshintshi.

lessons.title: Izitishi, abavelisi ne-mempool
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 9.3–9.5
lessons.body:
# Izitishi zokuqinisekisa (nodes)

**Isitishi sokuqinisekisa** yikhompyutha egcina ikopi yeleja yonke ye-Bitcoin.

Izitishi:
- zihlola yonke intlawulo nebloko
- zikhaba izinto ezingalandeli imithetho
- zabelana ngolwazi nezinye izitishi

Kukho amawaka ezitishi ehlabathini. Nawe ungavula esakho ngekhompyutha encinci. Akukho mntu unokutshintsha imithetho ngaphandle kokuba izitishi zivuma.

---

# Iingcali ezivelisa ii-bitcoin (miners)

[[picture:bd25-w19-1]]
[[picture:bd25-w19-2]]

Iingcali ezivelisa ziqokelela iintlawulo zizenze **ibloko**. Zikhuphisana ngokusombulula imathematika enzima ngeekhompyutha ezinamandla, nombane omninzi.

Ophumeleleyo:
- wongeza ibloko kwileja (i-blockchain)
- ufumana ii-bitcoin ezintsha nemirhumo yeentlawulo

Ibloko entsha yongezwa malunga nemizuzu eli-10. Le nkqubo ibizwa ngokuba yi-**proof-of-work**.

---

# Yintoni i-mempool?

Xa uthumela intlawulo kwileja, ayingeni kwibloko kwangoko. Ilinda kwi-**mempool**: indawo yokulinda yeentlawulo ezingekangeniswa.

Iingcali ezivelisa zikhetha kuqala iintlawulo ezinemirhumo ephezulu. Ukuba i-mempool ixakekile, umrhumo uyenyuka.

> Le yenye yezizathu zokuba i-Lightning ibalulekile: ayilindi kwi-mempool.

---

# Intlawulo ukusuka ekuqaleni ukuya ekupheleni

[[picture:bd25-w19-3]]

1. UThandi utyikitya intlawulo nge-wallet yakhe (isitshixo sabucala).
2. Intlawulo iya kwizitishi, ezihlolayo ukuba ilungile.
3. Ilinda kwi-mempool.
4. Ingcali evelisayo iyifaka kwibloko.
5. Ibloko yongezwa kwileja; zonke izitishi ziyayihlola.
6. USipho uyayifumana. Ngokuhamba kweebloko ezininzi, iyaqina ngakumbi.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

- Izitishi zigcina ileja kwaye zihlola imithetho.
- Iingcali ezivelisa zenza iibloko, zivuzwe ngee-bitcoin ezintsha nemirhumo.
- I-mempool yindawo yokulinda; imirhumo ephezulu iqala.
- Intlawulo: tyikitya → izitishi → mempool → ibloko → ileja.

lessons.body:
# Uze wafika!

Halala! Le yiveki yokugqibela ye-Bitcoin Diploma. Kule veki sijonga ukuba **kutheni** i-Bitcoin ibalulekile, nokuba ikamva linokuba njani.

---

# Ii-CBDC: imali ka-intanethi karhulumente

[[picture:bd25-w20-1]]

**Ii-CBDC** ziyimali ka-intanethi ekhutshwa yibhanki enguVimba. Ziyafana nemali yesiqhelo: zingaprintwa nanini na.

Kodwa zinika urhulumente amandla amatsha:
- ukubona yonke intlawulo yakho
- ukuthintela iintlawulo ezithile
- ukuvala i-akhawunti yakho

Ngokophando, ngaphezulu kwesiqingatha samazwe ehlabathini (119 kwangama-193) ajonga ii-CBDC.

---

# Imithetho esisiseko ye-Bitcoin

- **Inani eliqingqiweyo**: zi-21 yezigidi kuphela.
- **Akukho mntu unamagunya angaphezulu**: izitishi zabantu abaninzi zigcina imithetho.
- **Akukho mntu unokukuthintela**: ukuba uphethe isitshixo sakho, akukho mntu unokuthatha ii-bitcoin zakho okanye akuthintele ukuzisebenzisa.
- **Ivulelekile kumntu wonke**: akufuneki ibhanki, i-ID, okanye imvume.

# Iinzuzo ze-Bitcoin

- **Ukonga**: imali engenakuprintwa ingakhusela ixesha lakho nomsebenzi wakho.
- **Inkululeko**: ulawula imali yakho ngokwakho.
- **Ukufikeleleka**: nabani na onefowuni angayisebenzisa.
- **Iintlawulo ehlabathini liphela**: ngemizuzwana, ngomrhumo omncinci.

---

# Phinda ujonge imibuzo yakho

Khumbula imibuzo emihlanu yeveki 1:
- Kutheni sifuna imali?
- Yintoni imali?
- Ngubani olawula imali?
- Yintoni eyenza imali ibe nexabiso?

Ngaba iimpendulo zakho zitshintshile? Ngoku uyazi ngembali yemali, iibhanki, unyuko-maxabiso, i-Bitcoin ne-Lightning.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

- Ii-CBDC zinika urhulumente amandla okubona nokulawula iintlawulo zakho.
- I-Bitcoin inemithetho engenakutshintshwa ngumntu omnye.
- I-Bitcoin inika ukonga, inkululeko nokufikeleleka.

> Enkosi ngokufunda nathi! Qhubeka ufunda, ufundise abanye ekasi, kwaye ungathembi namnye: qinisekisa kuqala.
